actions.name: Bite

actions.name: Claw

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. 7 ([[d:1d8 + 3]]) Piercing damage plus 9 ([[d:2d8]]) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. 10 ([[d:2d6 + 3]]) Slashing damage. If the target is a non-Undead creature, it is subjected to the following effect. [[s:Constitution saving throw]] DC 10. The target has the [[c:Paralyzed]] condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text: [[s:Constitution saving throw]] DC 10, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the ghast. The target has the [[c:Poisoned]] condition until the start of its next turn. The target is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Life Drain.

actions.name: Necrotic Sword
actions.text: Melee attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. 6 ([[d:1d8 + 2]]) Slashing damage plus 4 ([[d:1d8]]) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Bow
actions.text: Ranged attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft. 6 ([[d:1d8 + 2]]) Piercing damage plus 4 ([[d:1d8]]) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.text: [[s:Constitution saving throw]] DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. 6 ([[d:1d8 + 2]]) Necrotic damage, and the target's Hit Points maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a Zombie under the wight's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at a time.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.text: Melee attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. 8 ([[d:1d10 + 3]]) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ([[d:3d6]]) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, its Hit Points maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Points maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.text: [[s:Wisdom saving throw]] DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. The target has the [[c:Frightened]] condition until the end of the mummy's next turn. The target is immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. 5 ([[d:1d6 + 2]]) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the [[c:Prone]] condition.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The wolf has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the [[c:Incapacitated]] condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Storm Blade
actions.text: Melee attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 feet. 12 ([[d:2d6 + 5]]) Slashing damage plus 7 ([[d:2d6]]) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Storm Bolt
actions.text: Ranged attack: +9 to hit, range 120 feet. 13 ([[d:3d8]]) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [[c:Prone]] condition.

actions.name: Create Whirlwind
actions.text: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder [Area of Effect] centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. [[s:Strength saving throw]] DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). While in the whirlwind, the target has the [[c:Restrained]] condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the [[c:Restrained]] target takes 21 ([[d:6d6]]) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.text: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.text: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
spellcasting.text: At will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic. each day: Create Food and Water (can create wine instead of water), Tongues, Wind Walk. each day: Creation, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift

actions.name: Hurl Flame
